40022314.author: पदार्थः
40022314.content: हते having been killed, तु indeed, लवणे Lavana, देवाः the gods, सेन्द्राः with Indra, साग्निपुरोगमाः with Agni at their forefront, ऊचुः spoke, सुमधुराम् very sweet, वाणीम् words, शत्रुघ्नम् to Shatrughna, शत्रुतापनम् the tormentor of enemies.

40022314.author: Translation
40022314.content: Indeed, after Lavana was killed, the gods, led by Indra and with Agni at their forefront, spoke very sweet words to Shatrughna, the tormentor of enemies.

40022315.author: पदार्थः
40022315.content: दिष्ट्या fortunately, ते your, विजयो victory, वत्स O dear one, दिष्ट्या fortunately, लवणराक्षसः the demon Lavana, हतः is killed, पुरुषशार्दूल O tiger among men, वरं a boon, वरय ask for, सुव्रत O virtuous one.

40022315.author: Translation
40022315.content: O dear and virtuous tiger among men, it is by good fortune that you have achieved victory and the demon Lavana has been killed; now, ask for a boon.

40022316.author: पदार्थः
40022316.content: वरदास्तु indeed givers of boons, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, सर्व all, एव indeed, समागताः have assembled, विजयाकाङ्क्षिणस्तुभ्यम् desiring victory for you, अमोघं fruitful, दर्शनं sight, हि indeed, नः our.

40022316.author: Translation
40022316.content: O mighty-armed one, all of us who have assembled here are indeed givers of boons, having desired your victory, and our presence here is certainly not in vain.

40022317.author: पदार्थः
40022317.content: देवानां of the gods, भाषितं speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, शूरो the brave one, मूर्ध्नि on his head, कृताञ्जलिः having made an anjali, प्रत्युवाच replied, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, प्रयतात्मवान् the self-controlled one.

40022317.author: Translation
40022317.content: Having heard the words of the gods, the brave, mighty-armed, and self-controlled Shatrughna, with folded hands placed on his head, replied.

40022318.author: पदार्थः
40022318.content: इयं this, मधुपुरी the city of Madhu, रस्या delightful, मधुरा sweet, देवनिर्मिता created by gods, निवेशं a settlement, प्राप्नुयात् may obtain, शीघ्रम् quickly, एष this, मे my, अस्तु may be, वरः boon, परः supreme.

40022318.author: Translation
40022318.content: Shatrughna requested that this delightful and sweet city of Madhu, which was created by the gods, quickly become a populated settlement, declaring this to be his foremost boon.

40022319.author: पदार्थः
40022319.content: तं to him, देवाः the gods, प्रीतमनसो with pleased minds, बाढम् So be it, इति thus, एव indeed, राघवम् to the descendant of Raghu, भविष्यति will be, पुरी city, रम्या beautiful, शूरसेना Shurasena, न no, संशयः doubt.

40022319.author: Translation
40022319.content: With pleased minds, the gods replied to Shatrughna, the descendant of Raghu, saying "So be it," and assured him that the city would indeed become a beautiful one in the region of Shurasena, without a doubt.

40022320.author: पदार्थः
40022320.content: ते they, तथा thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, महात्मानो the great souls, दिवम् to the sky/heaven, आरुरुहुः ascended, तदा then, शत्रुघ्नो Shatrughna, अपि also, महातेजाः highly effulgent/very powerful, तां that, सेनां army, समुपानयत् brought together/led

40022320.author: Translation
40022320.content: After the great sages spoke, they ascended to the heavens, and then the powerful Shatrughna gathered that army.

40022321.author: पदार्थः
40022321.content: सा that, सेना army, शीघ्रम् quickly, आगच्छत् came, श्रुत्वा having heard, शत्रुघ्नशासनम् Shatrughna's command, निवेशनं the establishment/settlement (of the city), च and, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, श्रावणेन in the month of Shravana, समारभत् began

40022321.author: Translation
40022321.content: That army quickly arrived upon hearing Shatrughna's command, and Shatrughna began the establishment of the city in the month of Shravana.

40022322.author: पदार्थः
40022322.content: सा that (city), पुरा city, दिव्यसङ्काशा resembling a divine city, वर्षे in the year, द्वादशमे twelfth, शुभे auspicious, निविष्टा established/settled, शूरसेनानां of the brave warriors (or the region of Shurasena), विषयः region/country, च and, अकुतोभयः free from all fear

40022322.author: Translation
40022322.content: That city, resembling a divine abode, was established in the auspicious twelfth year, becoming a region for brave warriors, free from all fear.

40022323.author: पदार्थः
40022323.content: क्षेत्राणि fields, सस्ययुक्तानि full of crops, काले at the proper time, वर्षति rains, वासवः Indra (the rain god), अरोगवीरपुरुषा having healthy and brave men, शत्रुघ्नभुजपालिता protected by Shatrughna's arm

40022323.author: Translation
40022323.content: The fields were full of crops, Indra rained at the proper time, and the region, protected by Shatrughna's arm, had healthy and brave men.

40022324.author: पदार्थः
40022324.content: अर्धचन्द्रप्रतीकाशा resembling a half-moon, यमुनातीरशोभिता adorned by the banks of Yamuna, शोभिता adorned, गृहमुख्यैः by prominent houses, च and, चत्वरापणवीथिकैः by squares, shops, and streets, चातुर्वर्ण्यसमायुक्ता endowed with the four varnas (social classes), नानावाणिज्यशोभिता adorned with various trades/commerce

40022324.author: Translation
40022324.content: The city, resembling a half-moon and beautified by the Yamuna's banks, was adorned with grand houses, squares, shops, and streets, inhabited by people of all four varnas, and bustling with diverse commerce.

40022325.author: पदार्थः
40022325.content: यच्च and which, तेन by him, पुरा formerly, शुभ्रं pure, लवणेन by Lavana, कृतं made, महत् great, तत् that, शोभयति beautifies, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, नानावर्णोपशोभिताम् adorned with various colors.

40022325.author: Translation
40022325.content: Shatrughna now beautifies that great and pure city, which was formerly created by Lavana, adorning it with various colors.

40022326.author: पदार्थः
40022326.content: आरामैः with gardens, च and, विहारैः with pleasure-grounds, च and, शोभमानं shining, समन्ततः all around, शोभितां adorned, शोभनीयैः with beautiful things, च and, तथा similarly, अन्यैः with others, दैवमानुषैः divine and human.

40022326.author: Translation
40022326.content: The city was adorned all around with gardens and pleasure-grounds, and beautified by other divine and human elements.

40022327.author: पदार्थः
40022327.content: तां that, पुरीं city, दिव्यसङ्काशां resembling a divine city, नानापण्योपशोभिताम् adorned with various merchandise, नानादेशागतैः arrived from various countries, च and, अपि also, वणिग्भिः by merchants, उपशोभिताम् adorned.

40022327.author: Translation
40022327.content: That city, resembling a divine abode, was adorned with various merchandise and beautified by merchants who had arrived from diverse lands.

40022328.author: पदार्थः
40022328.content: तां that, समृद्धां prosperous, समृद्धार्थः one whose purpose is fulfilled, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, भरतानुजः younger brother of Bharata, निरीक्ष्य having seen, परमप्रीतः extremely pleased, परं great, हर्षं joy, उपागमत् attained.

40022328.author: Translation
40022328.content: Shatrughna, the younger brother of Bharata, whose purpose was fulfilled, observed that prosperous city and attained supreme joy, being extremely pleased.

40022329.author: पदार्थः
40022329.content: तस्य his, बुद्धिः thought, समुत्पन्ना arose, निवेश्य having established, मधुरां Mathura, पुरीम् city, रामपादौ Rama's feet, निरीक्षे I shall see, अहं I, वर्षे in the year, द्वादश twelfth, आगते having arrived.

40022329.author: Translation
40022329.content: A thought arose in his mind that after establishing the city of Mathura, he would go to see Rama's feet when the twelfth year arrived.

40022330.author: पदार्थः
40022330.content: ततः then, सः he, ताम् that, अमरपुरोपमाम् resembling the city of gods, पुरीम् city, निवेश्य having established, वै indeed, विविधजनाभिसंवृताम् filled with various people, नराधिपः the king, रघुपतिपाददर्शने in seeing the feet of Rama, दधे placed, मतिम् mind, रघुकुलवंशवर्धनः the enhancer of the Raghu family lineage.

40022330.author: Translation
40022330.content: After establishing that city, which resembled the city of gods and was filled with various people, the king Shatrughna, the enhancer of the Raghu lineage, set his mind on seeing the feet of Lord Rama. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 70 ।। Thus ends the seventieth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
